name: Amazon Product Advertising API
description: Drupal helper for using the Amazon Product Advertising API 5 SDK.
project_description: A lean developer helper that wires the Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) PHP SDK (thewirecutter/paapi5-php-sdk) into Drupal. It exposes a single service (amazon_paapi.amazon_paapi) that builds and returns a ready-to-use, credential-configured SDK DefaultApi client, plus a settings form for the AWS access key, secret, host, region and partner/associate tag. Credentials can alternatively be supplied via environment variables, which override the stored config. The module ships no product-display features of its own: developers assemble GetItems / SearchItems / GetVariations / GetBrowseNodes requests directly with the SDK classes. A Test ASIN admin page runs a live GetItems request so integrators can inspect a real response. Unlike the amazon contrib module (media integration, search, etc.), amazon_paapi is purely a factory/wrapper for the SDK client.
